comments.author: Alex Kim
comments.body: All 11 templates on the shared layout. ESP scan green. Done.

content.text: All 11 templates on the shared layout. ESP scan green. Done.

Notification emails still use per-template HTML with inconsistent header/footer markup. Brand updates require touching 11 files, and three templates still miss the unsubscribe footer required by our ESP policy.

Migrate all notification email templates to the shared MJML layout (layouts/base.mjml) with slots for preheader, body, and footer. Convert issue_assigned, mention, digest_weekly, and export_ready first; remaining seven follow in the same PR if diff stays reviewable.
Done when every template renders through the MJML pipeline, litmus previews match design within the approved tolerance, and the ESP link-scan for unsubscribe succeeds on all of them.
